meta.name: task-coordination-strategies
meta.description: Decompose complex tasks, design dependency graphs, and coordinate multi-agent work with proper task descriptions and workload balancing. Use this skill when breaking down work for agent teams, managing task dependencies, or monitoring team progress.

copy.tagline_en: Break down complex tasks and coordinate multiple agents

howto.what: Claude 会把复杂任务拆成可并行的子任务,设计依赖图(blockedBy/blocks),按模板写出含目标、归属文件、验收标准的任务描述,并监控团队负载、在失衡时重新分配。
howto.when: 当你需要把复杂工作拆给多个 agent、设计任务间的依赖关系,或监控团队进度时使用。

say.text: 把这个全栈功能拆成可并行的任务,标出依赖关系
say.note: 产出任务清单和依赖图

say.text: 给鉴权模块写一份任务描述,要带验收标准
看看谁空闲谁超载,把待办任务重新分配
say.note: 先查任务列表再调整归属

howto.what_en: Claude breaks complex work into parallelizable subtasks, designs dependency graphs (blockedBy/blocks), writes task descriptions with objectives, owned files and acceptance criteria, and monitors workload, rebalancing when uneven.
howto.when_en: Use when breaking down work for agent teams, managing task dependencies, or monitoring team progress.

say_en.text: Split this full-stack feature into parallel tasks and mark dependencies.
say_en.note: Produces a task list and dependency graph.

say_en.text: Write a task description for the auth module with acceptance criteria.
Check who is idle or overloaded and reassign pending tasks.
